easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
The permanent that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to Life and Limb, causing Emeria Angel to trigger.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, choosing to create a creature token.
Repeat steps 2-3.
